classification.difficultyReason: Calculate average speed after converting mixed time units or both distance and time units.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A plane travels 800 km in 1 hour 15 minutes. What is the average speed of the plane?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Time}&=1+\frac{15}{60}=\frac54\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{800}{5/4}\text{ km/h}\\\text{Average speed}&=800\times\frac45\text{ km/h}\\\text{Average speed}&=640\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: A car travels 84 km in 50 minutes. What is the average speed of the car? Give your answer in kilometres per hour.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Time}&=\frac{50}{60}=\frac56\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{84}{5/6}\text{ km/h}\\\text{Average speed}&=84\times\frac65\text{ km/h}\\\text{Average speed}&=100.8\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Yusef walks the 2.1 km to the beach in 22 minutes. What is Yusef’s average speed? Give your answer in metres per second.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Distance}&=2.1\times1000=2100\text{ m}\\\text{Time}&=22\times60=1320\text{ s}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{2100}{1320}\text{ m/s}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{35}{22}\text{ m/s}\end{align*}$$
